entities.name: Mihály Varga
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mihály Varga is a Hungarian politician, who served as Minister of Finance from 2013 to 2024. He also served as Minister of Finance between 2001 and 2002. He has been a member of Fidesz since the party's founding in 1988. He was one of the party's four vice presidents between 2005 and 2013.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mihály Varga is a Hungarian politician, who served as Minister of Finance from 2013 to 2024. He also served as Minister of Finance between 2001 and 2002. He has been a member of Fidesz since the party's founding in 1988. He was one of the party's four vice presidents between 2005 and 2013.
